_readme: JR Kyushu's Ōmura depot (大村車両基地), from OpenStreetMap: where its lead leaves the main line (junction), and its storage tracks (storage: how many OpenStreetMap draws a six-car set long, their length, the middles of their south and north ends), for RealLineDepotSite.omura.
